description: This file is a PHP template used for rendering a reward selection page with dynamic content such as rewards, project info, and tracking pixels. It includes PHP embedded code for layout and content insertion, as well as JavaScript for UI interaction.

methods.name: $this->layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the page.

methods.name: $this->section
methods.description: Defines a section of content to be included in the layout.

methods.name: $this->supply
methods.description: Provides content to be inserted into the layout.

methods.name: $this->insert
methods.description: Includes a partial template into the current template with optional variables.

methods.name: $this->replace
methods.description: Ends the current section and replaces it or finalizes content insertion.

methods.name: $this->append
methods.description: Appends content to a section in the layout.
